name: Hitman's Skill Set
author: Hitman (DulajDil)
description: A small, opinionated set of everyday Claude Code skills — commit hygiene, debugging discipline, code explanation, PR writing, and test generation.

skills.tagline: Conventional commit messages read off the staged diff.
Format, build-check, commit, then push — with approval gates.
Reproduce, locate, hypothesise, verify, fix — no guessing.
Explain code: what, how, why, and the gotchas.
Draft a PR title, summary, and test plan from branch commits.
Thorough unit tests that follow the project's existing framework.
